summary: Focused frontend regression run (iteration 2) on the public URL covering the 4 requested flows. REGRESSION 1 PASS: seller@nexora.com login -> /seller/dashboard renders metric-revenue (৳0 / 0 orders / 8 products / 4.2 rating) + sidebar; seller-nav-products, -store, -themes, -subscription all render real content with zero console/page errors (StoreContext's new useAuth dependency did not break the seller tree). REGRESSION 2 PASS: customer added 2 products via quick-add (badge incremented, GET /api/cart showed 2 items server-side), logged out via account-logout (token cleared), then in a FRESH browser context (localStorage cart empty) logged in again -> /cart hydrated the 2 items with correct qty/subtotal ৳11,001 - backend cart sync + hydrate confirmed working. REGRESSION 3 PASS: /cart -> cart-checkout -> place-order works on both paths: (a) saved address selected, (b) '+ Use a different address' -> checkout-full_name/phone/address filled; both redirect to /account/orders, new orders appear (one order per shop, so a 2-shop cart yields 2 orders - expected), cart cleared locally AND server-side, and the new address is now persisted to /api/account/addresses (iteration-1 gap fixed). Out-of-stock handling verified by seeding the server cart with a stock=0 product + an in-stock product: place-order succeeded, only the purchasable item became an order, no 5xx, and stock decremented (Gym Duffel Bag 5 -> 3). REGRESSION 4 PASS: /shop/dhaka-threads and /shop/sweet-symphony each render 5 tabs (Home/Products/Collections/About/Reviews) with visibly distinct theming (Playfair Display serif + dark ink CTA vs Plus Jakarta Sans + orange accent CTA/pill tab) and distinct banners. No console errors anywhere. Backend suite intentionally not re-run.

ui_bugs.component: Checkout - '+ Use a different address' toggle
ui_bugs.issue: Button had no data-testid, so it was not automatable (my first attempt failed on get_by_text because the visual-editor wrapper splits the text into spans). Functionality itself works. I added data-testid="checkout-new-address".

integration_issues.flow: Checkout with out-of-stock item in cart
integration_issues.issue: Out-of-stock lines are silently dropped: backend skips them, clearCart() wipes the whole cart and the success toast says 'Order placed!' with no mention that an item was unavailable. User loses the item without any notice. Recommend surfacing the skipped/unavailable items from the checkout response (and keeping them in the cart).

issues: Fashion banner/product photos are abstract editorial shots with heavy blue/green colour casts and one product image contains overlaid text 'H13' - looks like stock filler rather than catalogue imagery for a fashion shop.

action_items: Optional UX: tell the customer which cart lines were skipped as out-of-stock instead of clearing the cart silently after place-order.
Optional content: replace the Dhaka Threads fashion banner/product images that have colour casts and embedded text.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreContext.jsx: the cart->/api/cart/sync push effect depends on hydrated.current (a ref), so if the hydrate GET is slow the first mutation after login is never pushed until another mutation occurs; consider using state for the hydrated flag. Observed working in practice (600ms debounce + fast hydrate) but it is a latent race.

StoreContext.jsx: on logout the local cart stays in localStorage and, since the merge on next login is union-based, a previous user's guest cart can be merged into the next account's server cart on the same browser. Consider clearing local cart/wishlist on logout.
Checkout.jsx placeOrder swallows the API error (catch -> generic 'Could not place order') so real backend validation messages (e.g. all items out of stock) are never shown.
seed_data_creation: No new users created. Created 4 test orders on customer@nexora.com (COD, pending) - the API exposes no order-delete for customers, so they remain in /account/orders. One TEST_ address was created via checkout and deleted afterwards (DELETE 200). Customer cart and server cart left empty. Stock side-effects from ordering: Gym Duffel Bag 5 -> 3; Palazzo Set / Gentle Foaming Cleanser unchanged-or-decremented as expected. Seller Dhaka Threads left published on GROW, no settings changed.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and accurate; customer@nexora.com/customer123 and seller@nexora.com/seller123 both work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart/wishlist now sync to backend (GET /api/cart + POST /api/cart/sync) - to seed a cart quickly, POST /api/cart/sync with the Bearer token from localStorage 'nexora_token' then reload the page so StoreContext hydrates (~3-4s). Checkout shows the saved-address picker when /api/account/addresses is non-empty; the inline form (checkout-full_name/phone/address/area/city) only renders after clicking [data-testid="checkout-new-address"] (newly added). Storefront tabs = store-tab-<home|products|collections|about|reviews>. Checkout splits a multi-shop cart into one order per shop, so do not assert orders_after == orders_before + 1. quick-add buttons are disabled for stock=0 products.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-1 blockers are resolved: StoreContext now hydrates from GET /api/cart|/api/wishlist on user change and debounce-pushes to the /sync endpoints, which is why the cart survived a fresh browser context; Checkout now POSTs the typed address to /api/account/addresses before /api/checkout, and commerce.py skips out-of-stock lines and decrements stock (verified 5 -> 3).
